entries.responsibility: Production same-artifact stored-solution checker shared by positives and negative controls.
findings: File-based check now requires a pre-save hash; actual file bytes are hashed in streaming blocks.
Dataset and solution tags are queried; detailed binding is enforced by the public numerical reader used by the acceptance driver, not by tag membership alone.
Missing structured solver settings or unreadable required Derived Values fail closed.
Scalar expectations reject empty, multiple, nonfinite and nonnumeric values; explicit receipt tolerances are used without widening defaults.

A generic evaluation exception is classified as missing/empty stored solution; this classification alone does not prove engine causality. Live negative evidence separately records the actual clearSolutionData mutation and public read failure.

Resumption correction: absence of all datasets now means DATASET_NOT_FOUND only; it no longer infers a prior clear operation. Native clearSolutionData negative retains dataset and is independently constructed/reopened.
limits: Direct fake model attributes remain supported for CONTROL_UNIT. Only a traceable engine snapshot can supply LIVE evidence.

entries.responsibility: Fresh isolated public MCP fixture construction, saved-file reopen, negative controls and owned lifecycle.
findings: Server is launched with run-local prefs and ephemeral port; no existing PID is adopted. Loopback authenticated API and LAN denial are checked against read-only existing configuration.
OwnedHost observes original UNKNOWN jobs before teardown, retains unresolved runtime, and checks PID birth/command identity before terminating private children.
A/B/C receipts bind artifact bytes and actual presave field readbacks; builder and reopen hosts have distinct private homes and model identities. Reopen performs readback without solving.
Seven negative controls invoke the same production checker; cleared solution, changed field and removed Derived Values use saved mutated native models and new-worker reload.

Idempotency assertion originally compared redacted transcript data with raw retry data. Corrected to compare original and retry raw data, retaining same job/operation and unchanged event checks; public_m3_20260922T0503Z passes.
Source start/end manifests include additions/deletions; any drift prevents final-source acceptance even when assertions pass.

Resumption review: study_fault_case constructs a real unbound native probe, verifies public study.run unknown/error envelope, reconciles original job, and compares exact-key retry job/operation identity and complete event logs. Transient/export fixture options record requested scope and source drift.
limits: Probe helper implementations and numeric/node/export helper modules are covered separately; this entry does not claim every exploratory probe branch was reread.
Local absolute default application/JDK paths are overridable via environment and describe this Mac runtime only.
